answer: A credible mechanism is to require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn from tasks, then slash that stake when independent reviewers confirm fraud. New identities cannot cheaply multiply influence: each one needs capital locked up, and successful sybils risk losing it. Reviewers can wander across task histories, using a trellis of linked, signed actions to spot clusters funded or controlled together; a prism of independent evidence makes false accusations harder. The defense raises the attacker’s cost per identity and per failed attempt.
